Window Cleaning in Park Ridge, IL

What's Included

Our window cleaners clean the outside of your windows with a water-fed pole system and deionized (pure) water, scrubbing glass, frames and sills with nylon and boar-hair brushes. Pure water has no minerals, so it dries spot-free with no soap left behind. Inside, we use professional squeegees and solution, then wipe down the frames and sills.

  • All accessible exterior glass, frames and sills scrubbed
  • Deionized water rinse that dries spot-free
  • Interior glass squeegeed edge to edge
  • Interior sills and frames wiped down
  • Shoe covers worn inside your home
  • Streak-free guarantee: if you see a streak, we come back

  • Exterior window cleaningfrom $150

Park Ridge Window Cleaning FAQ

Yes. We serve all of Park Ridge in Cook County. Park Ridge homeowners trust us for streak-free windows and spotless driveways. Call or text (224) 985-9327 or request a quote online, and we usually reply within a few hours.
